title: Not what I thought
text: Was initially glad to find this app but disappointed that I can’t look back on every past day I logged taking a medication. It only lets me look at a month before the current date. Was using this to keep track of when I take a medication through the year so this app is pointless for me. Just have to go back to pen and paper.

title: New update decreased user friendliness
text:
The most recent update has implemented an annoying feature that forces you to a “for you” page that shows an exploratory splash screen with app function reminders instead of the home page where I can track and mark meds as taken.

If I open a medication tracking app I don’t want to have to make multiple clicks to mark a med as taken. Either move my meds to the for me page or add your function reminders to the Home Screen.

This update is annoying.

title: Super app
text:
I have been using Medisafe for a couple years. I have been very pleased with the performance up until recently. It is now hard to open to open, and keep open. I just updated to IOS 26.5. Now I can’t get it over at all help!


I am now using iOS 27, and the latest release of Mefisafe. I am still having problems. The program only stays open for about 20 seconds can’t make adjustments to medications or input information. because it only stays open about 20 seconds and shuts down. I like the program, but that particular problem, if it persists I will try another program.

title: Good but not great
text:
The app is good, but their customer support is not. I requested a simple change for those of us who take multiple meds at a certain time. If you take multiple meds earlier then scheduled and you don’t spend all your time on this app, then you can’t get to the “set time” feature until after your scheduled time! They have refused to make a simple change and they never replied back to my request.

To get around this I changed the timing of all the meds to a much earlier setting which allows me to get to the “set time” feature.

title: Constant Crashing issue
text: Crashing constantly for last 6 months, please fix. The app is beneficial to the elderly to help us stay organized. Please fix crashing issue. I have successfully used this app for years and love it normally. Right now it sucks royal lemons.

title: Stopped working on Apple Watch
text: I have tried everything from shutting down and reinstalling and it will not even try to open.   Whatever update you did has not allowed me to use on my Apple Watch this past week.  Really like the app and use it on my iphone but was convenient for the Apple Watch.  Please advise if you will be doing a bug fix soon

title: New update causes the app to stop sending notifications
text: I have been using this app for years without many issues. Now after downloading the latest version of this app, it will not open up on the apple watch and it has disabled notifications. Even when attempting to turn on critical alerts, it just takes you to notifications in settings which is now defaulted to off and can’t be changed. I also can’t access the app on my Apple Watch. I’ve power cycled my phone and the notifications came back but is still stuck in default notifications off and won’t allow the user to turn it back on. Please fix this update right away and I will change my rating to 5 stars. Until then I do not recommend downloading the latest app s/w update.

title: Not working on Apple Watches
text: Please fixed cuz Medisafe app isn’t working on the Apple Watches and I need to get next update asap!!! Thanks
Phantom reminders I did not set, missing inactive, missing active meds, and history only shows this year.

title: Stopped syncing
text: This app I was worked great until about a couple years ago and no matter what I do it Will not sync correctly with my Apple Watch. It shows medicine that I no longer take. And the ones that I do take if I put I take them it does not sync it to my Medisafe on my iPhone.

title: Error message for every action
text:
I was going to give this app another try after being frustrated by it a few years ago. I updated the app to the newest version, attempted to add a medication and got an error message. When I selected the prompt to “Contact Support,” the window closed and the screen went blank. Add a note? ERROR. Add a diary entry? ERROR. Look at your profile? ERROR. Contact Support? ERROR. Connect Apple Health? ERROR.

The app is completely worthless.

title: Crashes
text: This app used to work fine. Now it crashes when I try to launch it on Apple Watch. That won’t work. Rumor has it the app is now requiring a subscription, so I probably won’t use it anyway. Fortunately, the stock Apple app seems to work fine.

title: App is broken
text:
Still broken. The app reminds you every 10 minutes to take a schedules dose. There is no way to change the time interval. So if are busy and can’t acknowledge the reminder, you could have a dozen or more reminders in less than an hour. It wastes battery life.

Still not fixed.

Still broken.

title: No Longer Works on Apple Watch
text: After the most recent update, Medisafe will no longer open on my Apple Watch. It shows the app is still there and shows it’s still available in the watch app store, but every time I try to open it, it fails. Not sure what’s going on, but I have chronic illnesses and have used this app on my watch for years, so please fix this issue. I need this to work to be able to keep up with my medication schedule while on the go.

title: Crashes on Watch and often takes multiple attempts to open
text: I just tried to open this app on my Watch and it crashed every time!! How is that helpful?!!!!! FIX IT!!!!😡👎🏻

title: Good app!!!
text: Remember to take your medicine on time!!

title: Works…more than necessary
text: It works, but even after marking the dose as “taken” it still sends me reminders over and over like I missed it.  That is the only reason I uninstalled it.  It has nice features like being able to match the med icon to what the medication looks like, and I like the refill reminder and the alerts to possible drug interactions.  So if you don’t mind hearing the notification go off for an hour, this is really a decent app.

title: Newbie w Suggestion
text:
Clever and useful. Thank you. Multiple suggestions: 1) Enlarge and/or increase contrast of the tiny, tiny little icons at top; 2) add Meal as a category and ask for Start and Finish time. Reason for this one? People who take Carbidopa-Levodopa 3-5 times a day as I do benefit medically from timing meals 30-60 minutes before or after finishing a meal. Most meals contain protein which defeats C-L effectiveness. 3) Provide for simultaneous use of 2 strengths of same medication. 4) Provide for history of medication changes. I.E. when a doctor is honing in on the best dose, I have been told to take 1 pill of one strength and 2 of a different strength; then three days later take 2 & 2.
5) Provide for recording symptom/side-effects/interactions.

title: Calculate the time
text: This app previously would auto calculate the next scheduled dosage, but now it only has the manual option which kinda sucks. For example I want to be able to tell it I’m taking a medication for 2 weeks everyday every 8 hours, starting on a Tuesday at 9am and have it adjust and auto tell me what time that is. I don’t like only having a manual input for each dose time.

title: Randomly changes dangerous dose and duration
text: Trying to taper off an prescription at 14 day intervals is too much for this app to handle. It will mix up the strength of the dose and change the dates you set to “as needed.” This is dangerous. Going back to paper, pen, and calendar. Too buggy to trust this app.

title: It’s okay!
text: I like the app to remind me to take my meds but, I’ve noticed after I mark them as taken in the morning, by the afternoon meditation it says I didn’t take my morning meds. I make 100% sure I mark them as taken and it is still gone in the afternoon. It doesn’t do it every single day but it does most days. Other than that it is a good app.

title: Time zone Hell
text: Please PLEASE fix the time zone problem. The wording when it asks which time to keep is very confusing. I always end up answering wrong, forcing me to manually change the times of all my meds. Give us the option to NEVER CHANGE THE TIME. If I have a drug scheduled for 9:30, I don’t care what time zone I’m in. Keep it at 9:30!

title: Was very useful but not now
text:
I have used the app for years and now it crashes all the time. It takes up to 30 attempts to open it. Contacted them and zero fixes but they told me they would fix it.
Then they told me to uninstall and reinstall it and lost years of data

text: Stop sending me review requests

title: Black Screen once again
text:
7/16/26 once again “black screen” seems to be an ongoing issue!

Well you’re really pushing me to give up this app especially since you’re going to start charging. I’ve used this app for years and hardly ever have a problem yet this past year it’s been the same problem at least once every week where I only get a black screen. I’ve complained about this for the past year. Guess I’ll have to switch to Apples built in medical reminders but I prefer yours because it’s more sophisticated WHEN it works.

title: glitches a ton
text: I really wanted to like this app after my old tracker disappeared, but the glitches make it hard to trust. It keeps flipping my morning and night doses for a twice-a-day medication, ignoring my attempts to fix it. Swapping medication times is a pretty serious bug for a health app—needs a fix ASAP

title: Unable to edit
text:
Once a med is entered and saved it is not possible to change the times of dose. The drop down edit menu does not have many options.  Cataract surgery eye drop reminders are
not recommended with this app. The three ocular drop meds are combined into one bottle now. It is not offered in the selections of eye drop drugs. The drops for each eye overlap as they start within two weeks of each other. I’m looking at other apps for this reason as I often need to change medications dose times  based on life schedules

title: Only saves 30 days history
text: I wish I’d known before I committed to this app that it only stores the last 30 days of history. I’ve been using it to track symptoms and medications for our cat. We showed up at the vet yesterday and found that I couldn’t see the history since the last time we brought him in. There were also a few minor glitches that I was willing to overlook because it had the features I wanted but now seeing that I don’t have all the history I’ve been diligently tracking, I’m really frustrated. What’s the point in allowing me to track symptoms and notes for each dose if the history isn’t saved.
